name: agi-enterprise-transformation-dashboard
description: Static-generated AGI enterprise transformation control tower derived from the process registry workbook.

scripts.build:data: node -e "const path=require('path'); const fs=require('fs'); const { buildDashboardData }=require('./src/excel-parser'); const data=buildDashboardData(path.join(__dirname,'AGI Enterprise Process Registry v1.xlsx')); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(__dirname,'public'),{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'public','dashboard-data.json'), JSON.stringify(data,null,2)); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'public','dashboard-data.js'), 'window.AGI_DASHBOARD_DATA='+JSON.stringify(data)+';'); console.log('Generated public/dashboard-data.json and public/dashboard-data.js');"
